subject.title: fix(media): OpenShell /sandbox media paths rejected, breaking image transfer

question: Must this PR demonstrate a real OpenShell attachment transfer before merge, or is the direct production-helper transcript sufficient for this filesystem-boundary change?
rationale: The implementation and regression tests are strong, but the repository's external-PR proof policy treats a real changed-flow run as a merge gate unless a maintainer explicitly accepts the remaining container integration uncertainty.

options.title: Require live OpenShell proof
options.body: Obtain redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording of an actual `/sandbox` attachment transfer plus an off-root rejection before merging.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof
options.body: Treat the production-helper transcript and focused tests as sufficient while explicitly owning the residual container integration risk.

recommendation.title: Require live OpenShell proof
recommendation.body: Obtain redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording of an actual `/sandbox` attachment transfer plus an off-root rejection before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this owner to the central media mapper, sandbox context, agent tool construction, and OpenShell configuration surfaces.
